priorityList: Cast Arcane Surge as your primary offensive cooldown to begin your burn phase.
Cast Touch of the Magi while Arcane Surge is active, or whenever it is available if Arcane Surge has more than 30 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) during your Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi windows.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges if Arcane Salvo is at maximum stacks (20).
Cast Arcane Barrage at the very end of Arcane Surge or Touch of the Magi if Arcane Salvo has 15 or more stacks.
Cast Arcane Missiles when Clearcasting is active, unless you are already at maximum Arcane Salvo stacks.
Cast Arcane Orb if you have fewer than 3 Arcane Charges to quickly build power, especially after casting Arcane Barrage.
Use Presence of Mind to cast Arcane Blast when you have fewer than 2 Arcane Charges and no Clearcasting procs.
Cast Arcane Pulse if you have fewer than 3 Arcane Charges and your mana is above 30%.
Cast Arcane Blast as your main filler to generate Arcane Charges and fish for Clearcasting procs.
Use Evocation if your mana falls below 10% and your major cooldowns are not about to expire.
Cast Mirror Image before combat or during downtime for defense.
Cast Arcane Barrage as a final action if the target is about to die.
